svg.title: Historical British Columbia coat of arms — faithful vector reconstruction
svg.desc: Reconstructed from the supplied historical black-and-white reference. Native cubic Bézier paths, solid black and white fills, transparent exterior. Motto lettering is outlined as eighteen individually editable glyphs. Gray cutout remnants have been removed from the open spaces beneath the lion and inside the distant horn. Geometry follows the supplied historical rendition rather than a modern replacement.
